Elena — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a draft MAP and the first cut of the ephemeral testcases bundle for your review. High-level proposal below:

MAP (proposed milestones)
1) Today (May 17): Redwood shares artifacts + MAP worksheet (attached)
2) May 18–19: EverRetail runs acceptance tests against provided prompt-pack; share results in worksheet
3) May 20: Final acceptance or remediation items; sign DocuSign MPA
4) May 21–Jun 04: Ephemeral access window (2 weeks)
5) Jun 05: Automated takedown; Redwood provides destruction statement and checksum report by Jun 07

Usage constraints (summary)
- Artifacts are provided for evaluation only; no derivative dataset creation or distribution.
- No attempts to re-identify masked records.
- Models may be benchmarked internally only; public benchmarks require prior written permission.

Security notes
- All PII fields have been token-masked; per your ask we included a PII-scope file describing fields masked and the masking approach.
- Access is delivered via ephemeral S3 signed URLs with 48-hour refresh tokens; we will rotate credentials on schedule.

Attachments: everretail-ephemeral-testcases-v1.zip, MAP-acceptance-worksheet.xlsx, DocuSign-MPA-EverRetail.pdf

Let me know any changes. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,

Elena / Priyom — quick add from the acceptance perspective.

I've sketched minimal acceptance criteria in the MAP worksheet (rows 4–9) but calling out here:
- Functional: prompt-level pass rate >= 85% on the golden promptset (we'll provide the runner script)
- Regression: no more than 5% delta in top-1 accuracy vs. baseline on probe suite
- Privacy: no PII leakage detected in 3rd-party scanner run (we will share scanner report template)

Operational notes:
- We'll require a single named sandbox account for the QA run; ephemeral creds will be scoped to IP allowlist and expire at close of window.
- If acceptance fails, remediation window = 3 business days with up to 1 supplemental handoff of corrected promptpack.

Attaching the MAP worksheet with acceptance checklist filled at a draft level.

Folks — technical note for the acceptance run so results are reproducible on Redwood and EverRetail sides:
- We recommend a fixed tokenization and detokenization script (attached in the ZIP) and a README that pins byte-pair merge vocab/version. Without pinned tokenization, top-1 scores can vary by a few percentage points across runtimes.

Elena — thanks for the questions. Short answers and final steps below.

Joinability: the provided ZIP contains only hashed identifiers; there are no persistent raw IDs or join keys included. We will also add a 2-sentence joinability statement to the DocuSign MPA to make this explicit.

Scanner & config: we recommend running the open-source detectPII v2.3 config (we included a scanner-config.json in the ZIP). If you prefer, we can run the scanner on the artifact and share the generated report prior to your acceptance run.

Split-window: confirmed. Here is the revised timeline we will put in DocuSign:
- Window A: May 21–May 27 (7 days)
- Gap (no access): May 28–Jun 03
- Window B: Jun 04–Jun 10 (7 days)
- Jun 11: automated takedown; Redwood provides destruction and checksum report by Jun 13.

Next steps (concrete)
1) I will update the DocuSign MPA to include the joinability statement and split-window schedule and send the DocuSign link by end of day today.
2) Marissa will provision the ephemeral S3 links and share credential lifetimes separately (cc'd).
3) Karthik will add the tokenization note to the MAP PDF.
4) You sign DocuSign; once signed we open Window A.

Attachments included: everretail-ephemeral-testcases-v1.zip (scanner-config.json, README-tokenization.md inside), MAP-acceptance-worksheet.xlsx, DocuSign-MPA-EverRetail.pdf

If you want Redwood to run the scanner and produce the report ahead of your run, reply-all with approval and we will schedule that for tomorrow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get this pilot going.
